name: task-tracker
description: A shared task tracker for agents and people working in one repository: claim tasks, declare the files you touch, get refused on overlaps, review. /tasks board pane, status line, a band for conflicts and reviews, toasts for blocked tasks.

python.title: Python command
python.description: The interpreter that runs the tracker CLI (Python 3.9 or newer). If it does not start, python, python3 and py are tried in turn.

identity.title: Your name in the tracker
identity.description: The name the /tasks pane acts as; the roles file gives it a level. Agents use --as <name> or TASKS_AS.

dbPath.title: Database path
dbPath.description: The SQLite file, relative to the project root (nearest folder with .git or .claude).

rolesFile.title: Roles file
rolesFile.description: TOML file of names and permission levels, relative to the project root. Missing: everyone may do everything. `task.py init` writes a template.

labels.title: Label vocabulary
labels.description: Comma-separated labels a task may carry. Empty: any label.

importers.title: Importers
importers.description: Comma-separated sources `task.py import` reads: a .py file or module defining records(ctx), or a command printing JSON records. None by default.

notifyCommand.title: Notify command
notifyCommand.description: Optional command run for each notification (besides the tracker inbox), with {to} {sender} {key} {prio} {text} filled in. Runs without a shell.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the status line, band and pane check the tracker for changes. 0 turns live updates off.
